trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed): T-DEFINITION DEFECT. The block defines the isospin variable as T = |Z - N|/2 (absolute value) but the first display carries q^{(Z-N)(A-1)/2} and the second carries +l.T.A - l.T. With T = |Z-N|/2 the two displays disagree for every neutron-rich nucleus (N > Z), where (Z-N)(A-1)/2 = -|T|(A-1). The sibling proof prf:eigenvalue-product-expansion states T = (Z-N)/2 and labels it 'signed isospin'. Proposed fix: change the statement to T = (Z-N)/2 (signed). Algebra otherwise verified exact: n_pp-n_nn = (Z-N)(A-1)/2, ZN = A^2/4 - T^2, so ln|Lambda_sym| = l.T(A-1) + l_2(A^2/4 - T^2) expands to exactly the four displayed terms.
